blocks.text: Christmas is always more magical when celebrated at SM, where every visit brings a reason to make the season brighter, more meaningful, and memorable. This holiday season, shoppers are invited to max out their Christmas experience at SM’s most-loved malls across Cebu, with spectacular holiday displays, festive attractions, exciting events, and a delightful mix of shopping and dining experiences that bring families and friends together. At SM City Cebu, the holiday festivities get even more exciting with the Holiday Stars Meet & Greet, happening every Saturday and Sunday throughout November at 3 PM at the North Wing Atrium.
